name: Lokmanni SS 304 Stainless Steel Hex Bolt, Nut & Spring Washer Assortment Set
shortDescription: Certified Grade A2-70 (AISI 304) stainless steel full-thread hex head bolts with matching hex nuts, flat washers, and split spring lock washers for corrosive environments.
overview: The Lokmanni SS 304 hardware assortment provides an uncompromising, corrosion-proof fastening system for civil infrastructure, coastal installations, chemical plants, and architectural glass assemblies. Forged from certified AISI 304 (A2-70) austenitic stainless steel containing 18% Chromium and 8% Nickel, these fasteners possess supreme resistance against atmospheric oxidation, water pitting, and chemical attack. Each bolt conforms strictly to DIN 933 full-thread standards and is paired with matching DIN 934 hex nuts, DIN 125 flat washers, and DIN 127 helical split spring lock washers.
keyFeatures: 100% Genuine AISI 304 (Grade A2-70) austenitic stainless steel construction
Supreme resistance to atmospheric rust, sea spray, acid rain, and chemical washdowns
Tensile strength exceeding 700 N/mm² for reliable structural load-bearing performance
Full-length precision rolled metric threads conforming to DIN 933 / ISO 4017
Includes heavy-gauge DIN 127 spring lock washers to prevent loosening under vibration
Mirror-polished, burr-free finish suitable for exposed architectural installations
Non-magnetic properties ideal for sensitive electronics and medical cleanrooms
